items.title: ENGINE EXCELLENCE #4 (§4): proof genuinely CONSUMED — requireProof policy closes accept bypass-by-omission
items.evidence: PR(this): closes the §4 gap 'a proof library is insufficient if another acceptance path can bypass it'. CONFIRMED GAP: campaign-controller.advance accepts ACCEPTED on a non-empty evidence STRING alone, and campaign-loop's mission-evidence gate only engaged when the executor RETURNED a proof ⇒ an executor could bypass the gate by OMITTING the proof (silent downgrade to the string path). FIX: campaign-loop.ts gains opts.requireProof (default false, backward compatible) — when ODG mandates proof, an ACCEPTED verdict WITHOUT a proof record is REFUSED (attemptFailed 'proof required but none provided'); wired into odg-campaign-run via ODG_CAMPAIGN_REQUIRE_PROOF=1 / opts.requireProof. Makes the proof genuinely CONSUMED on the autonomous acceptance path, not merely available. Tests (mission-evidence.test.ts +3 ⇒20): requireProof+ACCEPTED-without-proof⇒NOT ACCEPTED (bypass-by-omission refused); requireProof+valid-proof⇒ACCEPTED; default(no policy)+no-proof⇒legacy accept unchanged. Live: verification campaign w/ ODG_CAMPAIGN_REQUIRE_PROOF=1 ⇒ 3/3 COMPLETE (PASS lots carry proof). Regression: campaign-loop 13/13, odg-campaign-run 6/6, tsc 0. HONEST BOUNDARY: advance() stays a low-level primitive (string-evidence) used by human/CI/governed flows; requireProof governs the AUTONOMOUS loop path (the one that could silently downgrade). 9 primitives intact. Independent audit + CI. Gate: test:report green.
